column1: # stimulus_conditions.tsv -- condition labels for every stimulus file, used by
# trr_export_afni.sh to label each single trial for the two-condition TRR models.
#   task      BIDS task label (scripture / FHS / architecture)
#   stimulus  stimulus file name without .png, exactly as in the PsychoPy CSVs
#   yield     high / low. high = on the "high yield" list: stimuli that survey
#             responders, in a SEPARATE survey run before this study, more
#             consistently rated higher on the spiritual scale. low = every
#             other stimulus file of that task. Source of record:
#             high_yield_stimuli.R next to it). 7 listed stimuli were never shown
#             in the scanner (FH3 FH17 FH18 FH34 LDS_A_I_1 Out_M_I_2 Out_M_I_7).
#   faith     architecture only: lds (file name starts LDS_) or other (Out_).
#             NA for scripture and FHS (no such split in their stimuli).
# Rows: every .png stimulus in the PsychoPy task folders (Phase_1_MRI and
# Phase_2_MRI): S1-S50, FH1-FH40, and the 64 architecture images.
